programme.title: Vikramadithyan
programme.desc: Two close friends face various hurdles as they navigate the complexities of life while striving to realise their shared dreams.

programme.title: RX 100
programme.desc: Shiva has a passionate affair with Indu, a politician's daughter from the city. However, when they get separated, he becomes angry and prone to extreme violence.

programme.title: Bal Ramayan / Luv Kush
programme.desc: The story of Sita's exile by Ram, forcing her to wander forests with their children, Luv and Kush, which challenges traditional narratives, is presented.

programme.title: Hobu Chandra Raja Gobu Chandra Mantri
programme.desc: Hobu Chandra, the king of Bombagarh, rules the kingdom wisely. However, chaos ensues when he makes Gobu, his new minister.

programme.title: Swamir Ghar
programme.desc: Ajay, struggling in his life, finds his troubles worsening when he falls in love with Sangita, a woman from a wealthy family and a vastly different social background.

programme.title: Aamar Mayer Shapath
programme.desc: Three men steal jewellery from a temple and put the blame on a snake charmer. Vasanthi, the snake charmer's wife, vows to seek revenge against those who killed her husband.

programme.title: Naayak
programme.desc: Siddharth and Charan, two lookalikes who are fighting their own battles against evildoers, cross paths and join forces to take down Rawat, a ruthless minister.

programme.title: Devi
programme.desc: After returning from overseas, Arun marries Jaba, an orphan who contributes to the temple. But Arun's vindictive relatives try to drive the couple apart.

programme.title: Mej Didi
programme.desc: Seeking familial bonds, Keshta, an orphan, arrives at his step-sister's house. However, he is mistreated by some family members until he meets a woman who treats him like her own son.

programme.title: Aloukik 2
programme.desc: A newly married couple decides to move into an old house to begin their married life. However, the husband soon realizes that his wife is possessed and he must save her.

programme.title: Highway
programme.desc: Veera, a young bride-to-be, is abducted by a local gangster, Mahabir, and his men a day prior to her wedding. Far from being terrified of her abductor, Veera discovers a new meaning to her life.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: A father and daughter purchase an old run-down vintage car. However, unbeknownst to them, the car is possessed by a dangerous revenge-seeking spirit.

programme.title: Sathya
programme.desc: After his ex-girlfriend Shweta approaches Sathya to help her find her missing daughter, he decides to investigate. Confusion arises when Shweta's husband refuses to accept that they have a daughter.

programme.title: Miss Call
programme.desc: Leela befriends Krishna after using missed calls to scam him into recharging her phone and the two become close. However, he becomes the prime suspect when she goes missing.

programme.title: Saat Paake Bandha
programme.desc: Rahul agrees to marry his industrialist father's personal assistant to fulfill his wishes. However, Pallavi's dreams are shattered when Rahul imposes a condition about their marriage.

programme.title: Paglu 2
programme.desc: Dev, a high-school dropout, relocates to the city in order to finish his studies. Soon, he falls in love with a girl in his college, but things go awry when she is kidnapped by a group of hoodlums.

programme.title: Haami 2
programme.desc: An eight-year-old mathematics prodigy competes with other children in a reality show. As his talent gradually becomes a source of income for his family, the way he is parented begins to change.

programme.title: Agent Srinivas
programme.desc: While trying to investigate an unidentified body, Sai Sreenivas Athreya, an amateur detective from Nellore, runs into trouble.

programme.title: Ami Sudhu Tor Holam
programme.desc: A young man falls in love with the granddaughter of a retired colonel. When he decides to confess his love, he feels heartbroken upon discovering her relationship with another man.

programme.title: Byomkesh Hatyamancha
programme.desc: Detective Byomkesh Bakshi witnesses a murder when he attends a stage play. Soon, he investigates the case with his confidant and gradually unearths a story of love, betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Ashrita
programme.desc: After getting married in a contemporary family, a woman rebels against the maltreatment of her in-laws. Moreover, she vows to take action and gets help from another educated family.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: For his father's treatment, Kashi and his father move into a colony on the outskirts of Mumbai. But when Kashi sees a local gangster terrorise the colony, he decides to strike back.

programme.title: Meher Aali
programme.desc: Meher Ali, a Muslim boy who lives with his widowed mother, falls in love with a Hindu girl. However, his life turns upside down when he gets convicted as a terrorist and imprisoned for life.

programme.title: Tarakar Mrityu
programme.desc: A married couple sets off on a leisure trip to Kalimpong and stays in an attractive bungalow, but unexplainable incidents at the place lead them to face the truth behind an unsettled murder.

programme.title: Borunbabur Bondhu
programme.desc: Borun Chakraborty, a seemingly irritable and lonely old man, becomes the centre of attention in his family and the neighbourhood when he receives a letter from a famous former friend.

programme.title: Classroom
programme.desc: Teenagers enjoy their school life to the fullest, until a boy gets murdered in a classroom, and everyone in the institution comes under the radar of suspicion.

programme.title: Teko
programme.desc: Alok and Mina decide to get married because of their mutual obsession over hair. But their love is tested when Alok starts losing hair due to an unknown hair oil.

programme.title: Jekhane Bhooter Bhoy
programme.desc: Tarini Khuro narrates three ghost stories to a group of children from his fan club, which involves a ghost hunter, Anathbandhu, a mysterious entity, Simon, and a friendly ghost from the 19th century.

programme.title: Belashuru
programme.desc: While helping a family member diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease, a family learns to look at things from a different perspective and in turn mend their relationships with each other.

programme.title: Bolo Na Tumi Amar
programme.desc: Abhishek, a pizza delivery boy, agrees to marry Madhurima, a college student, when she is forced into marriage by her father. But trouble starts after a wicked inspector arrests her on false charges.

programme.title: Latthi
programme.desc: After being harassed by his family members, a retired teacher decides to teach them a lesson in order to discipline them.

programme.title: Love Story
programme.desc: A young couple must overcome internal conflicts and a series of problems that arise due to a criminal accusation in order to be united in love.

programme.title: Ami Je Ke Tomar
programme.desc: Aditya, a commitment-phobic hotelier, loves Esha, his innocent employee. Things get complicated when Esha's past comes to the fore, and he realises that Prachi, his associate, loves him.

programme.title: Gotro
